name: Unsatisfiable Outer-Domino-Wedge Carrier Profiles
definition: The only possible eleven-vertex terminal cut layer is a wedge of two degree-two-rooted dominoes. Its coordinate coloring has two profiles: five active coordinates when the middle directions are shared, and six when they are distinct. Encode each profile with eleven formal passive coordinates and every necessary terminal carrier constraint.
parameters: The shared-middle formula has 12,126 variables and 130,526 clauses; its checked core has 311,417 lemmas and 20,710,244 resolution steps. The disjoint-middle formula has 13,476 variables and 145,285 clauses; its core has 749,165 lemmas, 51,150,761 resolution steps, and 26,857 RAT lemmas.
properties: Both formulas are unsatisfiable. Because the formulas omit one-concept deletion co-pairs and preserve every passive inclusion and equality used by the carrier rules, they relax every genuine doubly blocked interval; their infeasibility excludes all terminal cut layers of order at most eleven.
